calculation: PROCESS_COUNTS([floc_tanks_used_in_the_plant]="yes" AS "Coagulation/Flocculation",[clarifier_sedimentation_tanks_at_the_plant]="yes" AS "Sedimentation/Clarification",[filtration_system_at_the_plant]="yes" AS "Filtration",[backwash_sludge_removal_system_at_the_plant]="yes" AS "Backwash sludge removal",[disinfection_technique] AS "Disinfection",[chemicals_are_use_for_water_treatment_on_the_day_of_inspection] AS "Chemical-specific")
STAGE_FLOW([has_ohs_policy] AS "Has OHS policy",[staff_use_ohs_equipment] AS "Staff use the policy",[staff_comply_ohs_policy] AS "Staff comply")

CHEMICAL_STACK([chemicals_are_use_for_water_treatment_on_the_day_of_inspection],chlorine=has_chlorine_gas_risks AS "Chlorine",potassium_aluminium_sulphate=has_alum_dosing_risks AS "Potassium Aluminium Sulphate (Alum)",polymer=issues_risks_associated_with_polymer_dosing AS "Polymer",lime=issues_risk_associated_with_lime_dosing AS "Lime",sodium_carbonate=has_soda_ash_dosing_risks AS "Sodium Carbonate (Soda Ash)")

BUCKET_BAR([there_plant_mag_flow_meters_in_place]="no" AS "No meter",[type_of_flow_meters]="inflow" AND NOT "outflow" AS "Inflow",[type_of_flow_meters]="outflow" AND NOT "inflow" AS "Outflow",[type_of_flow_meters]="inflow" AND "outflow" AS "Both")

GROUPED_STACK([backup_generator_condition]="yes" AND [has_backup_generator]="yes" AS "Generator · well maintained",[backup_generator_condition]="no" AND [has_backup_generator]="yes" AS "Generator · poorly maintained",[has_backup_generator]="no" AS "No back-up generator")
